title: VeriChip implant, Raytheon lineage, and retaliation suggestion

tellings.quote: The chip was introduced to the market in 2002, just a few years before Gary's experience in 2005.

plain: VeriChip, a tiny chip made to be implanted under human skin by the company Applied Digital Solutions, came to market in 2002 and has roots tied to the defense contractor Raytheon, according to Michels, who draws on the company's investor filings. He notes it came out "just a few years before Gary's experience in 2005," Gary being the hacker Gary McKinnon, who broke into NASA computers, and suggests the chip could have been part of retaliation against him. If true, it would mean the government used implant technology to punish someone who found its secrets.
